description: Main window capability. http is scoped to the pairing surfaces only (ts.net home serves over Tailscale HTTPS, loopback for dev and USB) — the packaged app talks to nothing else. websocket:default has no URL allowlist, so granting it widens what this app may dial, and nothing here narrows it back: src/lib/terminal/transport.ts restates the http list (assertAllowedShellEndpoint) and pins the socket to the paired origin (assertPairedWsUrl), but both are module-level correctness guards that any other code in this webview can bypass by calling the plugin directly — the boundary version is a Rust command that validates against the stored pairing (GDK-897). barcode-scanner and notification are registered for their later UI chunks. secure-storage plugin commands are deliberately NOT granted to JS: the token_get/token_set/token_del commands in lib.rs are the only door to the token.
